subtitle.en: Microsoft posted the Gamefest 2008 presentations, most of them with audio, including Ignacio's tessellation talk.
subtitle.zh: Microsoft 放出了 Gamefest 2008 的讲座资料，大多附带录音，其中包括他讲曲面细分的那一场。

translator.note: 源文只有一段，标题为译者所加。Gamefest 是 Microsoft 当年办的游戏开发者大会，保留英文。

blocks.en: I just realized that Microsoft recently released the [Gamefest presentations](http://www.xnagamefest.com/presentations08.htm), and that most of them are accompanied with audio recordings, including my talk about [rendering displaced subdivision surfaces using tessellation](http://www.microsoft.com/downloads/details.aspx?FamilyId=A484D275-9360-41DD-ABD4-86D4F1218D0C&displaylang=en).
blocks.zh: 我这才发现 Microsoft 最近放出了 [Gamefest 的讲座资料](http://www.xnagamefest.com/presentations08.htm)，而且大多数都配了录音，其中就有我讲[用曲面细分渲染位移细分曲面](http://www.microsoft.com/downloads/details.aspx?FamilyId=A484D275-9360-41DD-ABD4-86D4F1218D0C&displaylang=en)的那一场。
